prerequisites: List only required blocker issue numbers, or explain why none exist.
owner_and_capability: Name one owner and one bounded capability.
affected_packages: List every package in the cutover.
affected_tables: List every table, or state that no table is affected.
atomic_cutover: Describe one cutover with no fallback read chain or application dual write.
tests: List contract, RLS, transaction, and failure tests that apply.

runtime_evidence.source: Link the raw tracer export or review attachment.
runtime_evidence.workload: Describe the observation window, environment, volume, and operations.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: State each agreed threshold and why it is safe.
runtime_evidence.errors: Record count and rate by stable operation or error code.
runtime_evidence.pool_wait: Record DB-pool wait count and duration.
runtime_evidence.lock_wait: Record measured lock waits; do not substitute full statement duration.
runtime_evidence.job_duration: Record Worker duration, or state why it is not applicable.
runtime_evidence.job_retries: Record Worker retries, or state why they are not applicable.
runtime_evidence.job_backlog: Record Worker backlog, or state why it is not applicable.

rollback_and_cleanup: Describe rollback, the observation window, and deletion of replaced code.
exit_criterion: Name the measurable proof that the migration and ratchet cleanup are complete.
